corrections:
MATERIAL 1 - the joint-peak premise is false. The bear opens that 'the equity has tracked the metal to within a whisker of both their 52-week highs.' It has not. HBM's 52-week high is $32.15; the stock closed $31.87 on 2026-06-02, then fell to $20.36 on 2026-07-17 - a 36% peak-to-trough drawdown - while copper never left ~1.5% of its own high. At the record's $24.765 anchor the equity sat 23% BELOW its own 52-week high. The multiple compression the bear forecasts from a copper roll-over has already partly occurred independently of the metal, and partly reversed. The bear may still be right that the stock is expensive, but not because equity and metal are jointly pinned at their highs.

MATERIAL 2 - the price anchor is stale by 10.1%. risk_reward is computed 'From $24.765' (as_of 2026-08-04). HBM closed $27.265 on 2026-08-11 (mktcap $12.113B / 444.1M shares). The stock now trades ABOVE the $26.75 base fair value: upside is minus $0.53, not plus $1.99, and downside to the $14.50 adverse case is $12.78. The asymmetry the bear describes is worse than stated, not better - this correction runs in the bear's favour. No typed correction is emitted because the moved number is live_price, not one of the four correctable valuation levels; bear_px, base_fv_px and bull_px are each internally consistent with their own stated commodity decks and share count (444.1M confirmed: $12,113M market cap / $27.275).

MATERIAL 3 - the Q2 2026 revenue miss did not happen. The bear states 'the June 2026 quarter missed revenue expectations at $631.3 million against roughly $652 million.' The SEC-filed income statement (CIK 0001322422, filed 2026-07-29) reports revenue of $651,037,075 and gross profit of $266,847,232 - a 41.0% margin, and in line with the ~$652M consensus the bear itself cites. $631.3M is not the filed number, and it contradicts the record's own gm_trajectory field, which carries $651.0M for the same quarter. The Peruvian port deferral is real and is a genuine second occurrence in four quarters, but it did not produce a ~$20M revenue shortfall. What did miss was EPS: $0.28 against a $0.30 consensus. The 'operational fragility' pillar loses its headline number.
